findings.claim: Objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with flowr_endpoint_vjp derivative path and no pointcloud_delta_A set.

Score clock: learning window and curve support are [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing; label semantics are recorded affinities removed with equal score prior, so decoded affinity labels are unobserved rather than failures.

The landmark_00_soft_mass curve over observed support [0.0,0.49] is non-monotone: it rises from about -0.37 z early to a peak near 1.64 z around t=0.16, then declines to about -0.28 z at the end, with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict; the polynomial is not accepted (relative node RMSE 0.286).

The landmark_00_local_dy curve over observed support [0.0,0.49] drops from about 0.09 z at t=0 to about -1.26 z near t=0.05, then recovers toward roughly 0.13 z at the end, with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts; whole-window z is -0.30, so the early negative excursion is transient rather than a sustained offset.

The landmark_00_local_cxy curve over observed support [0.0,0.49] oscillates between roughly +0.74 z and -0.45 z with 9 sign changes and 14 strong sign conflicts; whole-window z is near zero (0.099), so there is no net window-level shift.

landmark_00_local_dx has first_rate_z -17.5 and last_rate_z +8.1 with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; whole-window z is -0.18, so the sign of the early-to-late contrast reverses within the observed window.

landmark_00_local_czz and landmark_00_local_cyy show opposite-sign first/last rate patterns (czz +15.2 then -6.3; cyy -36.5 then +17.1) with whole-window z of -0.31 and -0.58 respectively, consistent with transient rather than sustained coordinate displacement.

hypotheses.direction: no single direction; early positive then late negative rate
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the landmark_00_soft_mass curve over the same support showing a monotone trend with no sign change in its rate.
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_soft_mass coordinate contrast is non-monotone over the observed support: it rises early and falls late, so a single signed direction over the whole window is not supported.

hypotheses.falsifier: A curve read showing landmark_00_local_dy rate magnitude roughly constant across the window with no decay.
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dy contrast is dominated by an early negative excursion that decays toward the end of the window, so any reward shaping on this coordinate should be time-localized rather than applied uniformly.

hypotheses.falsifier: A curve read showing landmark_00_local_cxy with a monotone trend and a whole-window mean clearly separated from zero.
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_cxy contrast oscillates with large amplitude and near-zero whole-window mean, so it does not specify an absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves and summary tables were delivered, so no stage-boundary claim is made.
All continuous_trends rows report polynomial_accepted=false and extrapolation_allowed=false, so no extrapolation beyond the observed window [0.0,0.49] is supported.
Selection preference is association only; no descendant survival, last recorded joint-head scores or decoded final affinity labels were observed, so no claim about measured final benefit is made.
The coordinate features are untyped proxies in predicted endpoint world coordinates; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
Only landmark_00 features were inspected; other landmarks were not read and remain unqueried rather than absent.
